info.name: Authorises a user against the API

params.name: client_id
params.description: Client ID of the authenticating app.

items.docs:
This endpoint should be used to authorise a user against the API.

It will perform a redirect if the user successfully logged in and accepted/denied the request.

See the below code samples for how you might implement this in your code.

Python:
```python
 url = "https://uclapi.com/oauth/authorise/?client_id=123&state=1"

'''
  in a desktop app, script, or for testing
'''
import webbrowser
webbrowser.open_new(url) 
# note that you will also need some way receive the callback
# this can be done v

params.description: Secret code obtained from the authorise endpoint.

items.docs:
This endpoint should be used to obtain a token for use in the other API endpoints.

See the below code samples for how you might implement this in your code.

Python:
```python
import requests

params = {
  "client_id": "123.456",
  "code": "1",
  "client_secret": "secret",
}
r = requests.get("https://uclapi.com/oauth/token", params=params)
print(r.json())
```

Shell:
```shell
curl -G https://uclapi.com/oauth/token -d code=mysecretcode -d client_id=123.456 -d client_secret=secret
```
